parsed.reason: Uses first-person singular correctly ("I can make an intro"), no greeting, no exclamation, no emoji, no oversell. The reason given is only the shared stage, honestly stated, and it adds no invented details about the other family. It names the consent gate and offers a clear yes/no question. Grammar is clean. Mentions "another Hale household", which is a correct noun phrase for the other family. Minor weakness: "I think the two of them could get along" is a soft claim beyond the age fact, but it is hedged and reads as human.
